# Renewing and consuming formation: a dynamical distinction in one wear-law class

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Under an explicit no-recovery wear law, formation within the renewal rate continues at every step and keeps its renewal capacity. Formation whose pressure persistently exceeds the current renewal rate has a whole-unfolding total bounded by held conditions plus a triangular renewal bound, ceases from that time, and permanently loses capacity from its first excess. Formation sharing those conditions, under any allocation, ceases with it, including when two parts are each within renewal and only jointly exceed it. Consuming formation can form more at first, so a one-step count ranks it first; beyond that bound, every within-renewal continuation exceeds every beyond-current one. Under the broad reading that counts every formation event as generative, formal living significance recognizes both and the no-loss comparison C does not apply between them. The formal readings Ceaseless and KeepsCapacity each separate them and differ from each other. These distinctions contain no normative predicate and are sign-neutral; identifying them with 生生 is a reading and correspondence question.

Canonical source: [RenewingFormation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RenewingFormation.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The supplied WearLaw: pressure within renewal leaves the renewing organization unchanged; pressure beyond it (with positive rate) strictly lowers the rate; the rate never rises or recovers. A local law, not a claim about every process, and it carries much of the distinction's content.
- Beyond means each step's pressure exceeds the then-current rate (BeyondCurrent); BeyondRenewal, relative to the initial rate, is stronger and its results are kept as corollaries. Within renewal means each step's pressure lies between 1 and the initial rate; the KeepsCapacity characterization allows zero pressure.
- Part B explicitly uses G0 and C from GenerativeComparison with the broad reading that counts every realized formation event as generative, to show what that reading cannot separate; it is the AI's formalization, not Ren's G0, whose object is 生生. Ceaseless and KeepsCapacity are the AI's formal readings.

Stock, renew and demand correspond to held conditions of further formation, the rate of the organization restoring them, and the activity's formation pressure in one unfolding; they are differentiated aspects of one history, not independent owners exchanging resources. Which real processes satisfy the wear law requires case-specific evidence.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 check (run 20261008T192627.406862Z): RenewingFormation 42 theorems/60 declaration audits (22 with no dependency, 1 propext, 25 propext and Quot.sound, 12 also Classical.choice); no custom axiom, sorry or native_decide; the same run compiled GenerativeComparison, PracticalJudgment, ProtectionPriorityRival and 4 controls. Counts include helpers and corollaries. An independent review on 9 October accepted the first version (21 theorems) with corrections; the corrections were made as directed and Lean-checked, but the reviewer did not re-review the corrected version; see GENERATIVE-DISCRIMINATION-REVIEW.

Completes a descriptive distinction within one no-recovery wear-law class, with one shared condition on which the consumer depends, and its interface with G0 and C; the distinction follows from the supplied law. It does not cover externalizing consumption, does not represent recovery, growth or 更多, and does not show that the formal readings are 生生, that real processes satisfy the law, that consuming is worse, or that ceasing is defective; no optimizer is formalized.

- A one-step count reverses the whole comparison: with any held stock, some consuming pressure forms more than sustained formation at the first step. [RenewingFormation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RenewingFormation.lean)
- Counterexamples between readings: resting one step keeps capacity but is not Ceaseless; surging once and then continuing at the reduced rate is Ceaseless yet permanently loses capacity (wears_yet_ceaseless). [RenewingFormation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RenewingFormation.lean)
- Representational limit: under the event reading C ranks a single rest strictly below sustained formation (event_comparison_ranks_rest_below), because this law omits rest's restorative role. [RenewingFormation.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RenewingFormation.lean)
- The renewing organization neither recovers nor grows under this law; 更多 and rising complexity are not represented. Ceasing is not judged bad; finite fulfillment, rest and appropriate ending remain within living significance.
